_readme: FIAT FIGHT ART, the full pass (13 Oct, Matt: the slice reads; docs/design/fight_art.md): per site a plate (688x296) and a taller cover (688x160); per zone two gang members standing, firing, going down (128x192); the four heads the same three ways; your hands per weapon type (256x192). art/fight/.
The Parade's plate is the test's: copy art/fight_test/parade_plate.png to art/fight/the_parade_plate.png before or after the run.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_fight_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <name> ++ --force). Each stand is made before its poses, which use it.

jobs.description: A first-person view at crouching eye level, as if from behind cover in a light-gun arcade game, looking across overgrown allotments at the edge of a town: sheds of corrugated iron and old doors, runner-bean canes, water butts, a polytunnel with its plastic torn, a rusting wheelbarrow, a shed with its door hanging open. Nobody in the scene, empty and waiting. Composed for three figures to stand in later: clear open ground in the middle distance just right of centre, a dark doorway or gap on the left side well down the scene, and room in the right foreground. The ground runs across the lower third; the horizon sits a third of the way down. Realistic painted pixel art, soft overcast light, muted cool northern palette, worn and lived-in, post-collapse Britain on a grey day; no black outlines, not anime, not a cartoon, not glossy; no text, no logos.
